actual_observations: Large dashed stage boundaries group preparation, architecture and evaluation; dashed boundaries are not hypothetical relationships.
Parallel ultrasound views converge into one EfficientNetV2 block explicitly labeled shared weights.
Valid feature tokens show Mask:1; gray zero pads show Mask:0. A yellow CLS path enters attention and reaches the MLP head.
Positional Encoding is crossed out; Transformer says 8 layers, 8 heads. Evaluation thumbnails are illustrative at overview scale, not sources for precise values.
visual_evidence.scope: Complete original figure, including all panels; crops are children, never counted as additional cases

scientific_task.question: How are variable numbers of views from one lesion fused into a lesion-level prediction?
scientific_task.supported_claim: A shared CNN extracts per-view features; masked Transformer aggregation without positional encoding produces a CLS-derived malignancy probability.
cannot_conclude: Parallel views are not independent patients or independent model parameters.
Grad-CAM and ROC thumbnails do not prove causal explanation or clinical deployment benefit.
The overview does not establish every training detail such as hybrid-backbone freezing.

design_analysis.layout: Left preparation opens into a wider architecture lane; a lower evaluation lane separates model computation from testing. The explicit shared-weight label prevents duplicated views being read as independently parameterized branches.
design_analysis.color: Green valid tokens, gray padding and yellow CLS encode distinct roles; labels redundantly name them.
design_analysis.omissions: Training loss is not shown. A training diagram needs a separate label-to-loss path rather than inserting labels into inference.

transferable_rules: Use one shared encoder block or explicit tying marks across repeated views.
Show masking at the operation it constrains, and distinguish dummy inputs from missing measured information.
Set versus sequence semantics require positional-encoding and readout conditions, not the word Transformer alone.
Overview thumbnails must never supply invented precise result numbers.
nontransferable_content: Number of layers, heads, feature dimension and max views are study-specific.
Do not infer hybrid CNN freezing from a baseline subsection; request/inspect code or a specific statement before drawing it.
limitations_and_ambiguities: Paper Section 3.4 describes dummy images before extraction while the figure depicts zero pads alongside tokens: a high-level padding abstraction, not proof of an exact implementation location.
No source code inspected. The figure suggests Doppler and grayscale views but does not alone define modality-level preprocessing.
